title: Visiting a Maasai Village Respectfully
excerpt: A visit to a Maasai village can be meaningful or awkward. How to choose a respectful visit and what to expect.
body:
## Choose carefully

Some villages near the main roads are set up mainly for tourists. Others are real communities that receive visitors. Ask your guide or us for a visit where the community decides and benefits.

## What happens

You are welcomed, often with a dance, see inside a home, learn about cattle and daily life, and may be offered crafts.

## Respect

- Ask before photographing.
- Do not give sweets or money to children.
- Buy crafts if you want, without pressure.

## Learn

Ask questions about education, land, and how life is changing. See [the Maasai](/blog/maasai-culture-guide/).

## Payment

There is usually an entry fee per vehicle or person that goes to the community.
